extracted.intended_audience: general public, researchers, policymakers interested in CEQ and NEPA
extracted.subtask_description: Summarize the Council on Environmental Quality's statutory roles, responsibilities, and limits under the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA), including oversight of environmental impact assessments and coordination of federal environmental policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: CEQ mission: annual reporting and oversight
rubrics_metrics.description: The CEQ produces an annual report for the president on the state of the environment, oversees federal agency implementation of environmental impact assessments, and acts as a referee when agencies disagree over the adequacy of such assessments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains primary outputs and supervisory functions: annual state-of-environment reporting, oversight of agencies' NEPA processes, and dispute-referee role when adequacy of assessments is contested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Federal agencies' NEPA obligations
rubrics_metrics.description: Under NEPA, federal agencies must consider the environmental effects of their actions during their planning and decision-making processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the substantive statutory duty NEPA imposes on agencies; CEQ's work focuses on ensuring agencies actually consider environmental effects in plans and decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: NEPA's balancing objective ('productive harmony')
rubrics_metrics.description: NEPA requires balancing environmental, economic, and social objectives in pursuit of 'productive harmony' between humans and their environment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frames how agencies should weigh competing objectives when analyzing environmental impacts—NEPA is not solely environmental protection but requires consideration of broader societal factors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Oversight of environmental impact assessments (EIA/EIS)
rubrics_metrics.description: CEQ oversees federal agency implementation of the environmental impact assessment process and acts as a referee when agencies disagree over the adequacy of such assessments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers CEQ's role in supervising how agencies prepare Environmental Assessments (EAs) and Environmental Impact Statements (EISs), and intervening when adequacy disputes arise.

rubrics_metrics.name: CEQ chair responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: The chair of the Council on Environmental Quality serves as the principal environmental policy adviser to the US president, reports annually to the president on the state of the environment, oversees federal agency implementation of the environmental impact assessment process, and acts as a referee when agencies disagree over the adequacy of such assessments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Details the chair's advisory, reporting, oversight, and coordination duties with agencies and White House offices in developing environmental and energy policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inter-agency coordination and policy advancement
rubrics_metrics.description: Through inter-agency working groups and coordination with other Executive Office of the President (EOP) bodies, CEQ works to advance the president's agenda on the environment, natural resources, and energy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes CEQ's convening/coordination role across executive-branch entities to align federal environmental efforts and implement presidential priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limitations on CEQ rulemaking authority
rubrics_metrics.description: The United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit ruled in Marin Audubon Society v. FAA that the CEQ does not have the authority to create binding regulations under the National Environmental Policy Act.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies a judicially-recognized legal constraint on CEQ's ability to promulgate binding NEPA regulations, which affects how CEQ can shape NEPA implementation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent policy actions affecting CEQ regulations
rubrics_metrics.description: In 2025, the second Trump administration issued an interim final rule directing the CEQ to rescind all regulations it had made implementing NEPA since 1977.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes executive-branch policy changes that alter the body of CEQ regulations and thus change the administrative framework for NEPA implementation; signals that CEQ's regulatory environment is subject to administration-level action.
